In the ballistic regime ωL ≪ 1 , velocity flips are rare, leading to a fast exploration of the position space S and a comparatively slow exploration of the velocity space V . This results in the scaling ν ∝ ω . On the contrary, in the diffusive regime ωL ≫ 1 , the high frequency of velocity flips makes the exploration of V faster than the exploration of S .
